name: Inventory
title: Grid inventory, equipment, durability, and item-life ownership
summary: Item rules are documented in 19. The current design has a variable-footprint grid, stackable materials/consumables, separate currency, equipment slots, and repairable zero-durability items. Exact dimensions and weights remain open.
scenarioNote: Отдельный проигранный сценарий в этот импорт не входил.

points.text: Materials/stackable consumables stack; ordinary equipment/accessories are individual; currency is outside the grid.
The character has two universal hand slots and a shared necklace/amulet slot; full compatibility remains open.
At zero durability an item remains, is broken/unusable, and can be repaired.
Inventory belongs to the current Character Life; death and Legacy Cache boundaries remain in 07.
Strength is the primary source of Carrying Capacity; the formula remains open.

gaps: Final grid/stash dimensions, footprints, weight/capacity formula, requirements, and extracted-modifier persistence remain open.
